description: FIBRE-side self-test of the merged α_EM↔W_λ shared-wall acceptance gate (#3853), completing the ONE piece #3871's observable-side run explicitly left open. Uses the corpus's OWN fixed fibre data (NO scan): root ζ = e^{iπ/5} (order 2p₃=10, order-5-fibre holonomy, Galois-indexed by flats m=1,2), admissible set = 9 affine-Ê₈ McKay marks (1,2,3,4,5,6,4,2,3 = 2I irrep dims, Σmark²=120=|2I|; mark-5 truncates [5]_ζ=0, folding 2:1 onto the SU(2)_3 alcove {1,2,3,4}), value map d_ζ(λ)=[mark]_ζ (#3685). Combined with #3871 (observable D(q₀)=11.357 ∉{8,8π}), the α_EM↔W_λ shared wall is FALSIFIED ON BOTH SIDES: b₁=8 (genus-4 homology count) is bracketed by the two sides (fibre <8< observable) but equals NEITHER the fibre-truncated keystone D(ζ) nor the observable untruncated D(q₀). The α_EM per-loop measure 1/(π b₁) and the W_λ keystone 1/D are DISTINCT normalizations at every corpus-fixed evaluation — the two walls are fully distinct objects. Scope-(a) NEGATIVE (not a structural exclusion): refutes 'photon b₁ = keystone total quantum dimension D' against fixed data; does NOT exclude a non-D route (per-irrep d_λ, an index, a different combination). No fit; no α_k wired; 1/(8π) stays a phase-4 identification.
